## Execute Contract (EC)

The moment a contract comes into force: flips to `signed`, stamps signedAt (local calendar day) and `signatureStatus: signed`, and creates a ContractVersion snapshot (number allocated as max+1 for the contract) so "what did we agree that day" survives later amendments. Executing IS versioning — one command owns both writes so they can never disagree.

### Example

Natural target: the linked MSA — Northwind.

### Non-goals

No countersignature tracking per party. No document generation — executedCopyUrl records where the signed PDF lives.
